OPTION.TITLE: General options
OPTION.WARNING: ⚠️ Warning ⚠️, only modify if you're sure of what you're doing!!!! otherwise click on "default value" in case of error!
OPTION.AUTO_BANK_INFO: The bank sets the loan rate according to how scarce money is; players borrow whenever they want.
OPTION.AUTO_SEIZURE_INFO: In case of payment default, the bank automatically seizes coins then cards (the most expensive first), without waiting for the facilitator.
OPTION.TIER_HELP: Below the average shown, the loan moves to the tier; the lowest tier crossed wins. Base rate = default loan/interest above.
OPTION.BANKROUTE_WTD: In case of payment default, seize:
OPTION.SEIZURE_DECOTE: in card value with discount of:
OPTION.IF_PRISON: If loan not recovered, maximum prison
OPTION.GEN_LETTERS: Number of letters generated in game
OPTION.GEN_LETTERS_IDENTICAL: Identical number of cards generated in game and starting cards
OPTION.START_DISTRIB_CARDS: Number of cards distributed to players at game start
OPTION.BUILD_AMOUNT: Identical number of cards to build a superior card:

ACTION.TITLE: Actions
ACTION.ROBBED_STEAL: Someone stole a card from you!
ACTION.ROBBED_WAR: You were attacked! 2 cards were taken from you.
ACTION.SHOP_HINT: Produce a complete set to score points!

WHO_HAVE_CARD.LABEL: Who has this family?
WHO_HAVE_CARD.DESC: Find out who holds a card from a family you're missing. Costs 1 token.
WHO_HAVE_CARD.HINT: Select a card — you'll find out who holds a card of the same family.
WHO_HAVE_CARD.RESULT_PLAYER: {{name}} has a card of this family.
WHO_HAVE_CARD.RESULT_DECK: A card of this family is in the deck.
WHO_HAVE_CARD.RESULT_UNKNOWN: No one holds a card of this family right now.

GIVE.LABEL: Give a card
GIVE.DESC: Give one of your cards to a player of your choice.

STEAL.LABEL: Steal a card
STEAL.DESC: Take a card from another player. They will be notified.

SILENT_STEAL.LABEL: Silent steal
SILENT_STEAL.DESC: Take a card without the other player being notified.

WAR.LABEL: War
WAR.DESC: Steal 2 random cards from each of 2 players.

ONG.LABEL: ONG
ONG.DESC: Give 4 of your cards to the 2 poorest players (2 each).
